free_resources.title: Trauma Informed Practices on the App
free_resources.description: An interview on the app's blog introducing its free 'Trauma Informed Practice' folder of meditations, made with the EMBRACE sangha in the Plum Village tradition. It explains an invitational, trauma-sensitive way of practising mindfulness and why practising with a sangha matters.

flags: The post is the app team's interview with Jo-ann Rosen (EMBRACE sangha, author of Unshakable); the folder it introduces is the app's own, made with her sangha. It points readers to a sangha, a Dharma teacher or a mental health professional; no treatment claim. A human may judge whether an interview counts as the app's own resource.
